meta.name: caveman
meta.description: Ultra-compressed communication mode that cuts output tokens while keeping technical accuracy. Levels: lite, full, ultra and the wenyan variants. Use for /caveman, "caveman mode", "talk like caveman", "be brief" or "less tokens".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把 AI 啰嗦的回复压成简短回答，省下输出开销还保住技术要点。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果 AI 回答总是长篇大论，你只想看要点。
copy.tagline_en: Shrink AI replies into short answers while keeping the technical points intact.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if AI answers ramble on and you just want the key points.

howto.what: Claude 回复变成极简压缩风格:去掉客套、填充词和冠词,保留技术细节、代码和报错原文,输出更短。默认 full 档。
howto.when: 当你输入 /caveman,或说「caveman mode」「talk like caveman」等关键词时进入;此后整场会话默认保持,直到你说「stop caveman」或切回 normal。

say.text: /caveman ultra 用最省字的方式答我
用 caveman 模式解释这段代码
say.note: 只压缩风格,技术细节保留

howto.what_en: Claude replies in a terse, compressed style: drops pleasantries, filler and articles, keeps technical detail, code and exact error strings. Output is shorter. Default level: full.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you type /caveman or say "caveman mode", "talk like caveman" etc. It then stays default for the whole session until you say "stop caveman" or switch back to normal.

say_en.text: /caveman ultra, answer me in fewest words
Explain this code in caveman mode
